title: Hot Work Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Hot Work Job Safety Analysis template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.
html:
Project Information

JSA ID: HOTW-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

PROJECT: ______________ LOCATION: ______________ WORK TYPE: ☐ Welding ☐ Cutting ☐ Grinding

HOT WORK PERMIT #: ______________ FIRE WATCH: ______________ OPERATOR: ______________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Pre-Work Inspection & Permit-Combustibles in area
-Flammable atmospheres
-Improper ventilation		-Fire
-Explosion
-Injury		25 (VERY HIGH)-Complete hot work permit
-Clear 35ft radius of combustibles
-Cover floor/walls with fire blankets
-Test for flammable atmosphere
-Wet down surfaces if needed
-Post fire watch
2. Equipment Setup & Inspection-Damaged hoses
-Leaking gas
-Faulty regulators
-Improper storage		-Flash fire
-Explosion
-Asphyxiation
-Burns		20 (VERY HIGH)-Inspect all equipment before use
-Check torch and regulators
-Test for leaks with soap solution
-Secure cylinders upright
-Cap cylinders when not in use
-Store away from heat
3. Personal Protection & PPE-Arc flash
-UV radiation
-Sparks
-Fumes
-Noise		-Eye damage
-Arc eye
-Burns
-Metal fume fever
-Hearing loss		16 (HIGH)-Welding helmet with proper shade
-Fire-resistant clothing
-Leather gloves and apron
-Respiratory protection
-Hearing protection
-Leather boots (no cuffs)
4. Hot Work Operation-Sparks
-Slag
-Fumes
-Electric shock
-Hot surfaces		-Fire
-Burns
-Inhalation
-Electrocution
-Contact burns		20 (VERY HIGH)-Fire watch with extinguisher
-Monitor for fire during 30-min after
-Use local exhaust ventilation
-Insulate from ground
-Mark hot metal
-Warn others in area
5. Fire Watch Duties-Inadequate monitoring
-Leaving early
-Multiple fire locations		-Undetected fire
-Fire spread
-Injury		25 (VERY HIGH)-Fire watch remains during work + 30 min
-Extinguisher in hand
-Watch all areas (above/below)
-Know how to sound alarm
-Check for smoldering materials
6. Post-Work Inspection & Cleanup-Hot slag
-Smoldering materials
-Hidden sparks
-Gas left on		-Delayed fire
-Fire after work ends
-Property damage		20 (VERY HIGH)-Fire watch continues 30 minutes
-Inspect all areas
-Check walls and floors
-Remove all equipment
-Close gas valves
-Return cylinders to storage
